controls.statement: Ensure customer-facing status and support information can be updated during control-plane failure.
heading_trail: Final Gap Closure — Operational Acceptance, Service Transition, and Organizational Adoption
Service design for operability and supportability
controls.primary_reason: A control-plane failure can be simulated while independently exercising public status and support-information updates.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: During a simulated control-plane failure, authorized staff can update customer status and support information through an independent path.

controls.statement: Confirm every required operational and support role is staffed for the intended service hours and risk.
heading_trail: Final Gap Closure — Operational Acceptance, Service Transition, and Organizational Adoption
People, roles, competence, and staffing readiness
controls.primary_reason: Required roles, service hours, and approved coverage needs can be joined to staffing rosters and schedules.

primary_deterministic_clauses.statement: Every required operational and support role has named staffing coverage for all approved service hours and risk-driven coverage periods.
